/*
Write a program that prints out the following pattern, using as few lines of code as you can:

	###
	#_#
	###

	####
	#__#
	#__#
	####

	#####
	#___#
	#___#
	#___#
	#####

	######
	#____#
	#____#
	#____#
	#____#
	######
	
*/

// Enter your code below this line



// DO NOT ALTER CODE WRITTEN BELOW THIS LINE

function printToScreen(text) {
	const svg = d3
		.select("body")
		.append("svg")
		.attr("width", "100%")
		.attr("height", 40);

	svg
		.append("text")
		.attr("y", 37.5)
		.attr("width", 450)
		.attr("height", 40)
		.attr("x", -1000)
		.attr("font-weight", "bold")
		.attr("font-size", "20px")
		.attr("font-family", "Roboto")
		.text(text)
		.transition()
		.duration(1000)
		.attr("x", 37.5);
}
